_comment: Every value is taken from the manufacturer document named in 'source'.
capacity_ah: minimum capacity guaranteed by the datasheet (nominal value when no minimum is published).
max_charge_a: maximum charge current; the standard charge current when no maximum is published.
internal_resistance_ohm: DC resistance when published, otherwise the 1 kHz AC impedance (maximum when specified, typical otherwise).
mass_kg: maximum weight when specified, nominal weight otherwise.
Datasheets are revised; always check the latest revision before building anything.

cells.notes: Marketed as 3000 mAh; 2950 mAh minimum. Resistance is the 1 kHz AC impedance (max).
cells.source: Samsung SDI cell specification INR18650-30Q, version 1.0

cells.notes: 3000 mAh nominal (no minimum published). Resistance is the 1 kHz AC impedance (max).
Marketed as 3500 mAh; 3350 mAh minimum. Resistance is the 1 kHz AC impedance (max).
cells.source: Samsung SDI cell specification INR18650-35E, version 1.1

cells.notes: 4200 mAh typical, 4000 mAh minimum. Resistance is the DC value (10 A, 1 s, typical). Charge current is the standard value; no maximum is published.
cells.source: Molicel product data sheet INR-21700-P42A (80092, V4)

cells.notes: Marketed as 5000 mAh; 4900 mAh minimum. Resistance is the 1 kHz AC impedance (max).
cells.source: Samsung SDI cell specification INR21700-50E, version 1.0 (2018-07-11)

cells.notes: LiFePO4. 2.5 Ah nominal, 2.4 Ah minimum. Resistance is the 1 kHz AC impedance (typical). 10 A is the fast charge to 80 % SOC. The datasheet gives no cut-off; 2.0 V is where its discharge curves end.
cells.source: A123 Systems data sheet ANR26650M1-B, MD100113-02 (2012)
